title: intro_jerusalem
text: Many years ago, my family and I lived in Jerusalem. My father, a prophet of God, saw in a vision that Jerusalem would be destroyed.

title: intro_jerusalem

title: intro_bountiful
text: The Lord led us to a land which we called Bountiful, as it had much fruit and honey and was along the seashore.
